11.ai_answer: The Huaca del Sol (Pyramid of the Sun) was the largest adobe structure in the pre-Columbian Americas and served as the political and administrative center of Moche civilization. It demonstrated the Moche's organizational capacity, religious authority, and social hierarchy. The pyramid functioned as a royal palace, administrative hub, and burial site for elites, reflecting the theocratic nature of Moche society.

12.ai_answer: Mesolithic innovations included microlithic tools, fishing equipment, boats, and semi-sedentary settlements. Crop irrigation is not a Mesolithic innovation because agriculture had not yet developed—the Mesolithic was characterized by hunting, gathering, and fishing economies. Irrigation systems emerged later in the Neolithic period when farming became established, requiring water management for cultivated crops.
